entries.title: Square-lattice bond percolation conformal invariance: status audit
entries.statement: The precise C0017 question asks for Cardy crossing limits and chordal SLE6 convergence for critical p=1/2 bond percolation on the square lattice. A 2026-09-07 intake marked it attempted-unsolved, but Wang Zhou's arXiv:2409.03235v6 Theorem 2 and Corollary 1.1 claim the single Dobrushin-interface SLE6 and Cardy conclusions under Caratheodory domain convergence and Condition C. The 2024 preprint's proof has not been independently verified in this audit. The current resolved/open status of this narrower target is UNKNOWN; do not infer either status from the dated intake or the preprint abstract alone. The stronger full-plane nested CLE limit remains presented as a conjecture in arXiv:2502.08394 Conjecture 5.1, which does not decide the narrower theorem.
assumptions: Distinguish one Dobrushin interface from full-plane nested CLE convergence

entries.title: Standard q=1 FK parafermionic spin
entries.statement: In the standard FK edge parafermionic observable convention on a Dobrushin domain, the spin sigma lies in [0,1] and satisfies sin(pi sigma/2)=sqrt(q)/2 for 0<q<4. At q=1 this gives sigma=1/3. A historical C0017 attempt's value 2/3 is incompatible with this convention.
assumptions: Standard spin convention of Definition 3 in arXiv:1208.3787

entries.title: Attempt on conformal invariance of critical square-lattice bond percolation (source corrected)
entries.statement: Historical C0017-A001 attempted to obtain square-lattice critical bond-percolation conformal invariance using an FK parafermionic observable. In the standard convention for q=1, its spin is sigma=1/3, correcting the old record's 2/3. The known local relation at primal medial vertices alone leaves the dual-vertex relation uncontrolled; the attempt supplied no uniform conditional Cardy limit or SLE6 convergence proof. This is an attempt record, not a theorem or a verified current-open-status claim.
assumptions: Standard FK q=1 spin convention from arXiv:1208.3787 Definition 3

entries.title: Conditional identification of an SLE6 driver by two Cardy martingales
entries.statement: Let W be a continuous adapted real chordal Loewner driver, dg_t(z)=2/(g_t(z)-W_t)dt, and let 0<a<b<c. On a stopped interval where X=g_t(a)-W_t, Y1=g_t(b)-W_t and Y2=g_t(c)-W_t stay positive, bounded and uniformly separated, suppose C(X/Y1) and C(X/Y2) are local martingales in the same filtration, with C(u)=B(u;1/3,1/3)/B(1/3,1/3). Then W is a continuous local martingale on that interval with quadratic variation 6dt. This conditional lemma does not establish either Cardy martingale for square-lattice percolation.
entries.proof_text: Invert the strictly increasing smooth C on the compact ratio range to recover U=X/Y1 as a semimartingale. Since g_t(a),g_t(b) have finite variation, W=(g_t(a)-U g_t(b))/(1-U) is a semimartingale. Write W=V+N and Q=<N>. Ito applied to f(x,y)=C(x/y) gives dV=-(1/3)(1/X+1/Y_i)(dQ-6dt) for i=1,2, using Af=-3D^2f and D^2f/(2Df)=-(1/3)(1/x+1/y). Their difference has nonzero coefficient 1/Y1-1/Y2, hence dQ=6dt and dV=0 as signed measures.
assumptions: Uniformly positive stopped separation and finite upper bound
Both Cardy processes local martingales in the same filtration
entries.domain: Schramm-Loewner evolution and critical planar percolation

relations.rationale: The q=1 spin card states sigma=1/3; the corrected historical attempt card explicitly replaces its old sigma=2/3 statement.
The corrected attempt is explicitly C0017-A001; the audited C0017 card asks for the square-lattice SLE6 and Cardy limits.
The audited C0017 card asks for SLE6 interface convergence; the conditional lemma identifies the SLE6 driver only if two stopped Cardy martingales are supplied.
